🎬 Fountain of Youth (2025)

Fountain of Youth follows Luke Purdue, a daring treasure hunter who reunites with his estranged sister, Charlotte, for an extraordinary adventure in search of the legendary Fountain of Youth. Using their knowledge of history and ancient clues, the siblings embark on a dangerous journey across the world, uncovering hidden secrets and mysterious locations that could lead them to one of humanity’s greatest discoveries. As powerful enemies pursue the same treasure, Luke and Charlotte must overcome dangerous obstacles, unexpected betrayals, and unresolved family conflicts. With time running out, they discover that finding the fountain could change their lives forever. Combining thrilling action, clever puzzles, breathtaking locations, and entertaining humor, the film explores family, adventure, ambition, and the timeless human desire for immortality.

🎭 Genre: Action • Adventure • Fantasy • Mystery

⭐ IMDb: 5.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: 2h 5m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Guy Ritchie

🏆 Recognition: Starring John Krasinski, Natalie Portman, Eiza González, Domhnall Gleeson, and Stanley Tucci, the film features globe-trotting adventures, elaborate action sequences, and a modern treasure-hunting story.

📺 Where to Watch: Apple TV (Apple Original Film).

source_details.synopsis: Fountain of Youth is a 2025 American heist action adventure film directed by Guy Ritchie and written by James Vanderbilt. It stars John Krasinski, Natalie Portman, Eiza González, and Domhnall Gleeson, with Arian Moayed, Laz Alonso, Carmen Ejogo, and Stanley Tucci in supporting roles. Krasinski and Portman play estranged siblings who team up to embark on a journey to find the famed Fountain of Youth. Fountain of Youth was released May 23, 2025, on Apple TV+, and received mixed reviews from critics.
